My Journey

2022

First Line of Code

Wrote my first "Hello World" in Python. Had no idea it would become an obsession.

2023

Discovered Lua Scripting

Fell down the Lua rabbit hole. Game scripting opened a whole new world.

2024

UI/UX & Web Dev

Started designing interfaces and building full web applications. JavaScript became my daily driver.

2025

Building This Portfolio

155 themes, music player, video player, terminal, 16 mini-games — all pure HTML/CSS/JS. No frameworks.

Now

Exploring Rust & New Ideas

Currently diving into system-level programming with Rust. Always looking for the next challenge.
